Mia Chen: Heads up 1 Driftline POC: they reported mismatched token counts + generation truncation when running Llama-Adapter-13B variant. They use a custom tokenizer.
Samir Patel: Are they on the new byte-fallback variant or a forked tokenizer?
Mia Chen: Forked. Example they gave: 'Good morning' tokenizes to 5 tokens on their side, 4 on ours.
Jordan Lee: That gap will break KV cache alignment and cause early <eos> or truncation. Ask for a minimal repro snippet.
Mia Chen: Sent their snippet: ```python
text = \"Good morning\"
# their tokenizer -> tokens: ['G', 'ood', 'Ġmor', 'ning'] len=4
# our tokenizer -> tokens: ['Good', 'Ġmorning'] len=2
```
Samir Patel: Looks like different byte-level normalization and prefix spacing handling. If special tokens got remapped they could hit early stopping.
Oliver (infra): Also check if they remapped token ids (e.g., changed eos id). Converter warnings often mention token_map_mismatch.
Mia Chen: They ran llm-convert and got: 'warnings: token_map_mismatch for ids 400..410'.
Jordan Lee: Short-term mitigation: have them use our catalog tokenizer bundle for the POC and retokenize inputs. We host tokenizer artifact for redwood/llama-adapter-13b.
Mia Chen: I'll propose that. They also want p99 <120ms for 8k context on Dedicated with that variant.
Oliver (infra): For reserved Dedicated with 2xA100 class GPUs and tuned batching, p99 ~90-130ms is realistic. Provide sizing note and offer a 2-week dedicated trial.
Samir Patel: They require KMS + HSM attestation in the security questionnaire. For Hosted, offer BYOK via Private; for Private we can plug in their HSM and provide attestation docs.
Mia Chen: They asked for SOC2 and encryption evidence.
Samir Patel: Send compliance packet (link) and highlight Private deployment for stronger controls.
Mia Chen: If tokenizer map persists, what's our ops runbook?
Oliver (infra): Checklist: 1) confirm tokenizer artifact & version; 2) compare special token ids (pad, eos, bos); 3) retokenize canonical samples; 4) reproduce on our sandbox using their input with our tokenizer; 5) request converter artifact & token_map for deeper debug.
Jordan Lee: Commands to compare: ```bash
python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('their.json').encode('Good morning').tokens)\"
python -c \"from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('redwood/llama-adapter-13b').tokenize('Good morning'))\"
```
Mia Chen: I'll run the checklist with them. Can we offer conversion support as a scoped SOW?
Samir Patel: Yes, offer assistance in mapping tokens as a paid SOW but don't promise modifications to their internal converter.
Oliver (infra): I'll prepare sizing + SLA language and an estimated cost for 2-week Dedicated trial. Jordan: please add risk language for legal/security.
Jordan Lee: Adding: token_map mismatches can lead to silent data leakage or incorrect stop sequences; mitigation is using our tokenizer and validating output quality on a held prompt set.
Mia Chen: Thanks. Looping in Driftline contact and creating POC ticket. :thumbsup: 
sales-bot: POC ticket created -> https://redwood.salesforce.com/t/POC-6793012345
